Have you ever wondered how your phone knows which way it’s pointing, or how they got so small? In this video, we trace the incredible 100-year evolution of gyroscope technology, from Lawrence Sperry’s first airplane autopilot to ring-laser gyroscopes and the tiny MEMS sensors inside modern smartphones. Discover how gyroscopes and accelerometers measure rotation and movement, and learn more about how the principles behind these early mechanical systems were eventually condensed into sensors on a chip just 1mm wide.
